{{Quote|The classic! A grilled-to-perfection patty topped with all the fixin's&mdash;a slice of Gonzo yellow cheese, Revwien lettuce, topato slices, grilled Ojomian onions and B'omarr-style pickles.|Dex's Diner menu, on the Coruscant slider|<ref name="Menu" />}}
The '''B'omarr-style pickle''' was a type of [[Pickle/Legends|pickle]] used at [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]], a [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]] owned by a [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Chef/Legends|chef]] named [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]],<ref name="Menu" /> at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]].<ref name="DexDates">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}} is set at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]] per the {{DiningAtDexDate}}.</ref> Jettster used them in his [[Coruscant slider]], a [[slider]] inspired by the [[Time/Legends|time]] he had spent on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]].<ref name="Menu" /> The pickles were named after the [[B'omarr Order/Legends|B'omarr Order]],<ref name="Monks">{{Blog|narbflick|11|Dining at Dex's: The Story Behind the Story}}</ref> a mysterious religious group that believed in cutting off feelings and emotions to allow them to embark on mental journeys that were otherwise impossible.<ref name="ISWU">''[[The Illustrated Star Wars Universe]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Because we all know the B'omarr Monks are experts at pickling things.|Gregory Walker|<ref name="Monks" />}}
B'omarr-style pickles are mentioned in a [[2009]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]]-exclusive release, "[[Dining at Dex's]]" by [[Gregory Walker]], which represents the [[in-universe]] menu of Dex's Diner.<ref name="Monks" />
